digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and coaching moves overlay
propositions: A new advisory plan-review criterion project.symbol-reference-completeness coaches re-deriving source references with Serena's symbol tools plus a string-literal sweep the LSP cannot resolve.
The criterion routes to plan_review only because a project.* id can never enter code-review's closed applies_when vocabulary and would be a permanently dead move.
Code-review moves are already overlay-driven via load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring was added.

The overlay controls move applicability (proven deterministically), but the coach LLM controls selection; the advisory move always loses to blocking built-ins G1G2/G6/E4 that fire on the same incomplete-inventory evidence.
Live runs confirm the criterion fires at validity 1.0 on hand-enumerated plans naming the omitted monkeypatch.setattr site, and correctly abstains on complete inventories.
AC5 was amended by operator decision to require detection demonstrated live and coaching demonstrated as offered, rather than a run whose output contains the selected move.
